bounded_leaf_result.tested_scope: Deterministic local reasoning over predecessor reasoning STATE only; no public source, target call/mutation, protected/manual execution, hosted compute, finite quota, O/downstream/other-worker semantics, shared ledger, or legacy research.

checkpoint_record.stream_identity: A stable verifier-trace namespace/key fixed before the first row and unchanged across restart; mismatch is a fail-closed resume error.
checkpoint_record.summary: The canonical v1 incremental summary S from the predecessor slice.
checkpoint_record.summary_identity: The identity is the exact canonical UTF-8 JSON byte string of S under the fixed field names/order and canonical scalar/null/list encodings. A digest may be stored only as a compact alias and is valid only after comparison to those canonical bytes; correctness does not depend on a hash algorithm.

cursor.next_ordinal: Exactly S.rows_seen: the ordinal of the next unseen row.

checkpoint_record.last_row_identity: null for an empty prefix; otherwise the canonical identity of the complete row at next_ordinal-1 over every field/definedness bit that can affect any rejecting or semantic predicate.
checkpoint_record.atomicity: stream_identity, S, summary_identity, cursor and last_row_identity must be committed as one durable generation (or protected by one envelope identity). A mixed-generation or internally inconsistent record is rejected before semantic resume.

load_invariants: Recompute canonical bytes of S and require exact equality with summary_identity.
Require cursor.next_ordinal=S.rows_seen and cursor.last_consumed_ordinal=(null if S.rows_seen=0 else S.rows_seen-1).
Require S.first_rejection=null iff S.defects is empty; otherwise require S.first_rejection=S.defects[0] under the fixed (anchor_position,guard_rank,guard_code) order.
For nonempty prefixes require S.tail to describe input position cursor.last_consumed_ordinal; for the empty prefix require S.tail=null and last_row_identity=null.
Require stream_identity to match the resumed trace. Any invariant failure returns a fail-closed diagnostic and performs no extend transition.

resume_transition.normal: If the first delivered row has ordinal cursor.next_ordinal, call extend(S,row) once, advance the cursor to S'.rows_seen, and replace last_row_identity with the canonical identity of that consumed row.
resume_transition.duplicate_last_row: A single redelivery at ordinal cursor.next_ordinal-1 is a no-op only when its canonical row identity equals last_row_identity exactly. Do not call extend, do not increment rows_seen, do not modify defects/first_rejection/fail_seen/unknown_seen/tail/terminal_q, and then expect ordinal cursor.next_ordinal.
resume_transition.same_ordinal_mismatch: If a row arrives at cursor.next_ordinal-1 but its canonical identity differs, reject resume as conflicting replay; never silently deduplicate it.
resume_transition.gap_or_older_replay: If the next non-deduplicated row ordinal is greater than cursor.next_ordinal, or lower than cursor.next_ordinal-1, reject/fail closed rather than skipping or inventing rows.
resume_transition.post_step_persist: Persist the new checkpoint atomically only after extend has produced S'; a crash before persistence may cause at most the exact last row to be redelivered and suppressed by the duplicate rule.

restart_equivalence_proof.theorem: For every finite prefix P and suffix Q in the existing verifier scope, restoring a valid checkpoint after P and processing Q under this contract is observationally equivalent to uninterrupted fold-extend over P·Q for defects, first_rejection, fail_seen, unknown_seen, terminal_q and outcome. The same holds when restart redelivers exactly the last row of P once.
restart_equivalence_proof.proof: By the predecessor theorem, the persisted S equals the batch summary of P. Validated cursor.next_ordinal=|P| and tail is the exact predecessor boundary needed by every cross-row predicate. With normal delivery, the first new row is exactly Q[0], so deterministic extend applies the same local and pairwise predicates as uninterrupted scanning; induction over Q gives equality. With one exact duplicate-last-row redelivery, the identity check proves it is the already-accounted P[-1]; the no-op leaves S unchanged, after which execution reduces to the normal case. Conflicting same-ordinal replay, gaps, stale older replay, mixed-generation envelopes, or stream mismatch are rejected rather than converted into semantic evidence, so they cannot create a false PASS.
restart_equivalence_proof.scope_limit: This establishes verifier restart equivalence only. It does not prove crash-safe execution, idempotence, or exactly-once behavior for arbitrary external side effects.

field_necessity.fail_seen: Necessary for exact outcome and false-PASS prevention: losing historical H_d evidence can turn FAIL into a later PASS.
field_necessity.unknown_seen: Necessary for exact outcome and false-PASS prevention: losing a retained UNKNOWN barrier can turn UNKNOWN into a later PASS.
field_necessity.terminal_q: Necessary for exact semantic resume and PASS/UNRESOLVED identity; reconstructing it from an unavailable prefix is not permitted.
field_necessity.tail: Necessary for cross-boundary G_order/G_chain evaluation; omitting it can miss the first suffix-boundary defect and drift first_rejection or diagnostic validity.
field_necessity.cursor_next_ordinal: Necessary to anchor new defects and distinguish unseen rows from replay; an advanced cursor paired with an older summary can skip rejecting/fail evidence, while a regressed cursor can double-consume.
field_necessity.last_row_identity: Necessary when one-row replay is allowed: ordinal alone cannot distinguish an exact duplicate from changed content at the same ordinal; silent ordinal-only dedup can hide a rejecting or fail row.
field_necessity.defects: Necessary for full predecessor observable equivalence and to retain all accumulated rejecting defects. For first_rejection alone, only the minimum key is semantically sufficient, but the established verifier scope observes the complete canonical defect set.
field_necessity.first_rejection: Derivable from defects[0] and therefore not information-theoretically independent when defects are retained; storing it remains a checked cache whose invariant catches drift/torn state.
field_necessity.rows_seen: Information-equivalent to cursor.next_ordinal. Keeping both is deliberate redundancy checked on load; at least one authoritative consumed-count is necessary.
field_necessity.summary_identity_and_atomic_envelope: Necessary structural protection against torn or ABA-style mixtures of cursor and summary. Without a single-generation check, a valid-looking advanced cursor can be paired with stale flags/defects and skip evidence, enabling false PASS or first_rejection drift.
field_necessity.summary_version_and_stream_identity: Necessary interpretation/domain separators: a structurally identical record from a different contract or trace must not be resumed as this verifier state.

bounded_checks.R0: Normal restart at next_ordinal reduces directly to predecessor prefix-extension equivalence.
bounded_checks.R1: Exact last-row redelivery is a pure no-op before extend and cannot introduce a same-ordinal G_order/G_chain defect or duplicate semantic evidence.
bounded_checks.R2: Changed content at last_consumed_ordinal is not deduplicated; identity mismatch fails closed.
bounded_checks.R3: Cursor/rows_seen or first_rejection/defects mismatch fails before scanning, preventing a mixed-generation checkpoint from skipping evidence.
bounded_checks.R4: Because fail_seen and unknown_seen are restored before any suffix transition and remain OR-monotone, restart cannot clear historical FAIL/UNKNOWN into PASS.

falsifiers: An exact duplicate-last-row replay changes any verifier-observable field after resume.
Two different row contents at last_consumed_ordinal compare equal under last_row_identity even though they differ on a field/definedness bit used by any guard or semantic transition.
A checkpoint with cursor.next_ordinal different from S.rows_seen is accepted.
A checkpoint with stale fail_seen, unknown_seen, defects or tail but an advanced cursor is accepted as the same atomic generation.
Resume followed by any V0-V9/C0-C4 suffix disagrees with uninterrupted scanning on first_rejection, fail_seen, unknown_seen, terminal_q, diagnostic axis, semantic axis or accepted.
The verifier restart theorem is used to claim exactly-once arbitrary external side effects.
